# Optional Research Source Checkout

This folder is intentionally empty in the distributed plugin. Run `scripts/fetch_research_sources.sh` on a networked machine to clone a reviewed set of upstream repositories for comparison. The script records exact commits in `FETCHED_SOURCES.json`.

Checked-out repositories are research material, not runtime dependencies and not automatically licensed as part of this plugin. Do not commit or redistribute them without reviewing their licenses and notices.
